grammar_focus: if 条件句(主考:第一类真实条件 if + 一般现在时,主句 will/won't/祈使句/can · 前置后置 · 从句用现在时不用 will)+ 主谓一致(辅考:集合名词 police/family 用复数 · 就近/就前 as well as/neither nor)
scene: 停错车通常会被警察贴罚单 · 但在瑞典度假时车上发现一张客气的便条——欢迎光临本市、此处禁停、请留意路牌、这只是提醒

grammar_card.title: 说"如果…就…"(if 条件句)
grammar_card.intro: 本课讲怎么说"如果满足某个条件,将来就会怎样"——if 条件句。注意:if 后面那半句用一般现在时,后半句才用将来时(will)。全用本课句子举例。

rows: if + 一般现在时,另一半用将来时 will
If you park here, a police officer will find it.
if 那半句(说条件)用现在时,不用 will
If it rains tomorrow(不是 will rain), we will stay home.
if 这半句可以放句首(加逗号)也可以放句尾
If you hurry, you'll catch it. = You'll catch it if you hurry.
后半句也可以是 won't / 祈使句 / can
If you make a mistake, correct it. / If he can, he will come.

specialRules.rule: if 条件疑问:if + 现在时 + 疑问(If you see him, will you tell him?)
police(警察)是集合名词,后面的动词用复数:Traffic police are polite(主谓一致)

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What was the polite request?
options: A friendly note asking the driver to obey the No Parking signs

passage: If you park in the wrong parking lot, a police officer will find your car fast. You will be lucky if the officer lets you off without a ticket. However, that does not always happen. Traffic police are sometimes surprisingly polite. On a trip downtown in Sweden, I found this friendly note on my car: "Welcome to our city! This is a No Parking area. You will enjoy your stay here if you pay attention to our street signs. We have your license plate, but this note is only a reminder." If you get a polite note like this, you cannot fail to obey it. A kind reminder often works better than an angry ticket. If you ever visit this city, you will surely feel welcome.

stage5.stem: if 条件句用来说什么?
options: 如果满足条件,将来就会发生的事

stage5.stem: "If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay home."(rain,if 那半句用现在时)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果明天下雨,我们就待在家里。

stage5.stem: "If you park here, a police officer ___ your car."(find,后半句用将来)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果你停在这儿,警察会找到你的车。

stage5.stem: if 那半句(说条件的)可以放在:
options: 句首(后加逗号)或句尾都行

stage5.stem: 下面标点正确的一句是:
options: If you hurry, you will catch the bus.
If you hurry you will, catch the bus.
If, you hurry you will catch the bus.
You will catch, the bus if you hurry.

stage5.stem: "If he is working, I ___ disturb him."(后半句:不去打扰)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果他在工作,我就不去打扰他。

stage5.stem: "If you make a mistake, ___ it."(if + 让人做某事:改正它)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果你犯了错,就改正它。

stage5.stem: if 条件句里,表示将来的事,if 那半句里的动词用:

options: If it rains, we will stay home.
If it will rain, we will stay home.
If it will rains, we stay home.
If it rain, we will stayed home.

stage5.stem: "If you see him, ___ you tell him about it?"(if + 疑问)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果你见到他,你会告诉他这件事吗?

stage5.stem: "You ___ the train if you don't hurry."(miss,后半句将来)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果你不快点,就会错过火车。

stage5.stem: "If they can help you, they ___."(条件成立,主句表将来)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果他们能帮你,他们会帮的。

stage5.stem: police(警察)这个词,后面的动词一般用:
"Traffic police ___ sometimes very polite."(police 用复数)
stage5.stem_cn: 交通警察有时非常客气。

stage5.stem: "My family ___ all early risers."(把家人看成一个个成员,用复数)
"The father as well as his children ___ here."(as well as 跟前面的 father)
stage5.stem_cn: 父亲和他的孩子们都在这儿。

stage5.stem: as well as / with / along with 连接两个名词作起点时,动词跟:
"Neither you nor he ___ right."(neither…nor 跟离得近的 he)
